title: 4 Ways to Tell a Great Story

cues.text: Your first job as a speaker is to build a trusting human bond
cues.en: Your first job as a speaker is to build a trusting human bond
cues.zh: 演講者首先要做的，

cues.text: with your audience.
cues.en: with your audience.
cues.zh: 和聽眾建立連結的 一個好方法，就是說故事。

cues.text: One excellent way to connect to an audience is to tell a story.
cues.en: One excellent way to connect to an audience is to tell a story.
cues.zh: 和聽眾建立連結的 一個好方法，就是說故事。

cues.text: Stories helped make us who we are.
cues.en: Stories helped make us who we are.
cues.zh: 故事塑造了我們， 讓我們成為今天的樣子。

cues.text: Really — evidence left behind from our ancient ancestors
cues.en: Really — evidence left behind from our ancient ancestors
cues.zh: 真的，我們的遠古祖先 留下的證據顯示，

cues.text: suggests that the human mind developed alongside human storytelling.
cues.en: suggests that the human mind developed alongside human storytelling.
cues.zh: 人類心智的發展， 是隨著說故事的能力一起進步的。

cues.text: Fire created a new magnet for bonding.
cues.en: Fire created a new magnet for bonding.
cues.zh: 火堆提供人們情感連結的凝聚力。

cues.text: Its warmth and flickering light drew people together after dark.
cues.en: Its warmth and flickering light drew people together after dark.
cues.zh: 天黑之後，火的溫暖與搖曳的光芒， 將人們聚集在一起。

cues.text: This seems to have happened in every ancient culture
cues.en: This seems to have happened in every ancient culture
cues.zh: 過去三十萬年來，

cues.text: over the last 300,000 years.
cues.en: over the last 300,000 years.
cues.zh: 這樣的情景似乎出現在 每一個古老文化中。

cues.text: And what did our ancestors do with this time together?
cues.en: And what did our ancestors do with this time together?
cues.zh: 那麼，我們的祖先會利用 這段團聚時光做什麼事呢？

cues.text: In many cultures,
cues.en: In many cultures,
cues.zh: 在許多文化裡，

cues.text: one type of communal activity became very important: storytelling.
cues.en: one type of communal activity became very important: storytelling.
cues.zh: 有一項共同活動顯得特別重要， 那就是說故事。

cues.text: Stories brought people from faraway places to the fireside.
cues.en: Stories brought people from faraway places to the fireside.
cues.zh: 故事把來自遠方的人吸引到火堆旁。

cues.text: Stories about people who were alive and people who were dead,
cues.en: Stories about people who were alive and people who were dead,
cues.zh: 故事描述活著的人，也講述死去的人；

cues.text: nearby and in distant lands.
cues.en: nearby and in distant lands.
cues.zh: 故事裡有附近的人， 也有生活在遙遠土地上的人。

cues.text: Stories sparked laughter, tension, and amazement.
cues.en: Stories sparked laughter, tension, and amazement.
cues.zh: 故事讓人笑、讓人屏息，也讓人驚嘆。

cues.text: Stories also played an important role in helping expand people’s ability
cues.en: Stories also played an important role in helping expand people’s ability
cues.zh: 故事另一個重要功能是

cues.text: to imagine and to dream, and to understand the minds of others.
cues.en: to imagine and to dream, and to understand the minds of others.
cues.zh: 幫助人們拓展想像力與夢想，

cues.text: Storytellers became important people within a community,
cues.en: Storytellers became important people within a community,
cues.zh: 說書人逐漸成為社群中的重要人物，

cues.text: and their listeners took information from the stories
cues.en: and their listeners took information from the stories
cues.zh: 而聽故事的人也會 從故事中得到一些訊息，

cues.text: that changed how they behaved in the world.
cues.en: that changed how they behaved in the world.
cues.zh: 進而影響他們看待世界和行事的方式。

cues.text: It's not just that we all love hearing stories.
cues.en: It's not just that we all love hearing stories.
cues.zh: 這不只是因為每個人都喜歡聽故事，

cues.text: Stories probably helped shape how our minds share and receive information.
cues.en: Stories probably helped shape how our minds share and receive information.
cues.zh: 而是故事很可能早已形塑了 我們分享與接收資訊的方式。

cues.text: So it's no surprise that many of the best talks are built around a story.
cues.en: So it's no surprise that many of the best talks are built around a story.
cues.zh: 難怪，許多精彩的演講 都是以故事為核心。

cues.text: The most basic way of breaking down a story is this:
cues.en: The most basic way of breaking down a story is this:
cues.zh: 最基本的故事結構，可以這樣拆解：

cues.text: a character with a goal meets an unexpected obstacle.
cues.en: a character with a goal meets an unexpected obstacle.
cues.zh: 一個角色，有追求的目標， 遇上了意料之外的障礙。

cues.text: She tries to overcome that obstacle, which builds to a peak in the action.
cues.en: She tries to overcome that obstacle, which builds to a peak in the action.
cues.zh: 她試著克服這個障礙， 情節因此逐漸推向高潮。

cues.text: Finally, there’s some kind of resolution to the conflict.
cues.en: Finally, there’s some kind of resolution to the conflict.
cues.zh: 最後，衝突以某種方式獲得解決。

cues.text: When it comes to sharing a story from the stage,
cues.en: When it comes to sharing a story from the stage,
cues.zh: 如果你要在臺上分享一個故事，

cues.text: remember four key things:
cues.en: remember four key things:
cues.zh: 請記住四件重要的事。

cues.text: 1. Base the story around a character your audience can empathize with.
cues.en: 1. Base the story around a character your audience can empathize with.
cues.zh: 第一，讓故事圍繞著一個 聽眾能夠產生共鳴的角色。

cues.text: 2. Build tension,
cues.en: 2. Build tension,
cues.zh: 第二，營造緊張感，

cues.text: either through curiosity, relationship with other characters, or actual danger.
cues.en: either through curiosity, relationship with other characters, or actual danger.
cues.zh: 可以勾起好奇心、發展人物關係， 或加入真正的危險。

cues.text: 3. Offer the right level of detail.
cues.en: 3. Offer the right level of detail.
cues.zh: 第三，提供適量的細節。

cues.text: If there's not enough, the story won't come to life.
cues.en: If there's not enough, the story won't come to life.
cues.zh: 如果細節不夠，故事就無法鮮活起來；

cues.text: If there's too much, it will get bogged down.
cues.en: If there's too much, it will get bogged down.
cues.zh: 但如果細節太多，故事又會拖泥帶水。

cues.text: And, 4. End with a satisfying conclusion, whether it’s funny, moving, or surprising.
cues.en: And, 4. End with a satisfying conclusion, whether it’s funny, moving, or surprising.
cues.zh: 第四，用令人滿意的結尾收束故事， 不論結尾好笑、感人，還是出人意料。

cues.text: Some great talks are built around a single story.
cues.en: Some great talks are built around a single story.
cues.zh: 有些精彩的演講， 就圍繞著一個故事展開。

cues.text: This can be really helpful for a speaker.
cues.en: This can be really helpful for a speaker.
cues.zh: 對演講者來說，這是很有幫助的，

cues.text: The throughline is simply the plot of the story.
cues.en: The throughline is simply the plot of the story.
cues.zh: 因為故事的情節本身， 就能成為整場演講的主線。

cues.text: If the story is about you, it can even create empathy in the audience.
cues.en: If the story is about you, it can even create empathy in the audience.
cues.zh: 如果故事講的是你自己的經歷， 還能讓聽眾對你產生同理心。

cues.text: If your journey is exciting and easy to follow,
cues.en: If your journey is exciting and easy to follow,
cues.zh: 如果你的故事精彩，情節又清楚易懂，

cues.text: this type of talk can work really well.
cues.en: this type of talk can work really well.
cues.zh: 這種演講方式就能發揮很好的效果。

cues.text: But there's a trap here too.
cues.en: But there's a trap here too.
cues.zh: 但這裡也有一個陷阱。

cues.text: Remember, the goal is to give.
cues.en: Remember, the goal is to give.
cues.zh: 別忘了，演講的目的 是要帶給聽眾一些東西。

cues.text: Personal stories may entertain or interest an audience,
cues.en: Personal stories may entertain or interest an audience,
cues.zh: 個人故事也許能娛樂或吸引聽眾，

cues.text: or make the speaker feel really good about themselves,
cues.en: or make the speaker feel really good about themselves,
cues.zh: 或者讓演講者自我感覺良好，

cues.text: but they don’t necessarily give the audience
cues.en: but they don’t necessarily give the audience
cues.zh: 但不一定能讓聽眾得到有價值的東西，

cues.text: something they can walk away with;
cues.en: something they can walk away with;
cues.zh: 例如新的觀點、實用的資訊、 看事情的脈絡，或一點希望。

cues.text: a new way of understanding things, actionable information, context, hope.
cues.en: a new way of understanding things, actionable information, context, hope.
cues.zh: 例如新的觀點、實用的資訊、 看事情的脈絡，或一點希望。

cues.text: And that’s a real shame.
cues.en: And that’s a real shame.
cues.zh: 如果沒有這些，那就真的很可惜。

cues.text: The key is to link together the important moments of your story
cues.en: The key is to link together the important moments of your story
cues.zh: 關鍵在於，要把你故事中 那些重要的時刻串聯起來，

cues.text: in a way that can be meaningful to someone else.
cues.en: in a way that can be meaningful to someone else.
cues.zh: 讓它們對其他人也具有意義。

cues.text: Otherwise, it may sound like you're just rambling
cues.en: Otherwise, it may sound like you're just rambling
cues.zh: 否則，聽起來就可能像是在東拉西扯，

cues.text: or speaking for the sake of hearing yourself talk.
cues.en: or speaking for the sake of hearing yourself talk.
cues.zh: 只是為了自己想說而說。

cues.text: But, if the journey reveals something powerful you have learned,
cues.en: But, if the journey reveals something powerful you have learned,
cues.zh: 然而，如果你想藉由這個旅程 揭示某個你學到的重要道理，

cues.text: and if each step in your journey is revealed with humility and honesty
cues.en: and if each step in your journey is revealed with humility and honesty
cues.zh: 而你又能以謙遜、誠實 和坦然面對脆弱的態度，

cues.text: and vulnerability,
cues.en: and vulnerability,
cues.zh: 呈現旅程中的每一步，

cues.text: it is a journey we will gladly take with you.
cues.en: it is a journey we will gladly take with you.
cues.zh: 那麼我們就會很樂意 和你一起走完這段旅程。

cues.text: There is one other piece that is absolutely essential
cues.en: There is one other piece that is absolutely essential
cues.zh: 如果你打算說自己的故事，

cues.text: if you’re going to tell your own story:
cues.en: if you’re going to tell your own story:
cues.zh: 還有一點非常關鍵：

cues.text: it has to be true.
cues.en: it has to be true.
cues.zh: 這必須是個真實的故事。

cues.text: This may seem obvious,
cues.en: This may seem obvious,
cues.zh: 這聽起來也許很理所當然，

cues.text: but sometimes speakers are tempted to exaggerate
cues.en: but sometimes speakers are tempted to exaggerate
cues.zh: 但有時候，講者會忍不住誇大其詞，

cues.text: or even make a story up entirely.
cues.en: or even make a story up entirely.
cues.zh: 甚至乾脆捏造整個故事。

cues.text: Stories can have such a big impact that some speakers
cues.en: Stories can have such a big impact that some speakers
cues.zh: 故事的影響力有時很大，

cues.text: are tempted to bend the truth.
cues.en: are tempted to bend the truth.
cues.zh: 因此有些演講者會忍不住 加油添醋，甚至扭曲事實。

cues.text: But even small exaggerations can quickly destroy your reputation.
cues.en: But even small exaggerations can quickly destroy your reputation.
cues.zh: 但即使只是些微的誇大， 也可能很快毀掉你的信譽。

cues.text: It's not worth the risk.
cues.en: It's not worth the risk.
cues.zh: 不值得冒這種風險。

cues.text: When you combine a truthful story with a desire to benefit others,
cues.en: When you combine a truthful story with a desire to benefit others,
cues.zh: 當你說的故事是真實的， 目的只是想給別人幫助，

cues.text: you can give your listeners an extraordinary gift.
cues.en: you can give your listeners an extraordinary gift.
cues.zh: 你送給聽眾的就是一份非凡的禮物。

cues.text: A story can affect people deeply.
cues.en: A story can affect people deeply.
cues.zh: 故事能夠深深觸動人心。

cues.text: Use it, and you can greatly increase your connection with an audience.
cues.en: Use it, and you can greatly increase your connection with an audience.
cues.zh: 善用故事，就能讓你 和聽眾建立更深的連結。

cues.text: But please, let it mean something.
cues.en: But please, let it mean something.
cues.zh: 但請記得，你的故事要有意義。
